name: python-van-emde-tree
title: van Emde Boas Tree
blurb: A van Emde Boas tree over the fixed universe [0, 256): successor, predecessor, and membership equal the brute-force scans on seeded insert/delete/seek storms, the walk equals sorted(live) after every move, and empty-set seeks answer None, checked by a shipped audit.
default_description: A van Emde Boas tree over [0, 256) whose seeks equal the brute-force scan on any seeded workload.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
